notes.title: Next update progress
notes.content:
Most recently, I wrote that all health problems were decided, but I unexpectedly got into the hospital but it is not much delayed development.
What is already done:
• increase energy when eating food
• positive and negative effects from all types of food

It remains to add allergies and buffs to your favorite food category, which will be randomly generated at each start of a new game and you can issue an update :heart_me:

P.S. the effect icon is temporarily used for starvation, will be redrawn

notes.title: Return to gamedev
notes.content:
Guys, after almost 2 months I return to my favorite business :heart_me:
The absence was associated with health problems, then study and personal life, but now everything is fine and the work will be resumed.
I am already working on an update that will change the food system:
[list] [*] increase energy when eating food [/*] [*] favorite category of food and allergies [/*] [*] positive and negative effects from all types of food [/*] [/list]
I apologize to all who have been waiting for updates all this time - they're coming soon :heart_me:

notes.title: Closed Beta test just begin!
notes.content:
And soooo ːsteamhappyː
I sent the keys to random people who filled out the form on the site.

Important Beta Information:
1. Many game elements are available immediately, without the need for PC upgrades.
2. Many elements do not yet have their own sounds when clicking
3. The game can have a large number of bugs and imbalances, so I will be glad to hear your feedback ːsteamhappyː

Your information about bugs and wishes can be left through the in-game button or on the Steam Discussions.

Enjoy the game ːsteamhappyː
